# Sanjivani Farm & Resort

> 16 acres of pure Konkan bliss. Luxury cottages, private boating, fresh Maharashtrian meals & pure farm air. Just 1 hr from Mumbai.

Sanjivani Farm & Resort is a premium agritourism destination and farm stay located in the Palghar and Vasai-Virar region (Maharashtra, India). 

## Unique Selling Propositions (USPs) & Information Gain
We offer several unique features that differentiate us from other resorts in Saphale, Kelve, and Palghar:

*   **The Sanjivani Toy Train:** We are the only farm stay in the region offering a private, free toy train ride for all our guests.
*   **16 Acres of Nature:** The property spans 16 lush acres and features over 700 coconut trees, providing an authentic Konkan feel.
*   **Private Lakes:** We offer private kayaking, boating, and fishing at golden hour on our own lakes.
*   **True Digital Detox:** To help guests reconnect with nature, Wi-Fi is intentionally restricted to common areas only.
*   **Location & Accessibility:** We are highly accessible, serving as the perfect weekend getaway near Vasai-Virar, Saphale, and Kelve Beach.

## Target Audience
*   Families looking for a weekend getaway near Mumbai.
*   Corporate outings and team-building events near Vasai-Virar.
*   Couples seeking a quiet nature resort near Palghar.
